We know that human calorie restriction is beneficial to health in many ways, but [doesn't add more than a few years to life span](https://www.fightaging.org/faq#slow-aging) - while no actual assessment has been carried out, it would be hard for an effect of more than five years or so to remain hidden from interested [epidemiologists](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epidemiology) and scientists across the course of history.
